summary: Ferry County lookout: 1915 cabin, 1930 20-ft L-4 tower, 1963 timber tower; last tower removed or destroyed 1975; summit now a drive-up with communications towers.

facts.design: Log cabin with roof platform (1915); 20-foot L-4 tower with cab (1930); 20-foot treated timber tower with R-6 flat cab (1963)
facts.status_note: Last lookout removed or destroyed in 1975. SummitPost reports communications towers now at the summit.

corrections.why: 4.9 m is 16 feet, the height a September 1930 Republic newspaper item said would be built. The Register, firelookout.com and Willhite all give 20 feet for the tower built in 1930, and Willhite and the Register give 20 feet for the 1963 tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1930 newspaper item says 16 feet; the Register, firelookout.com and Willhite give 20 feet for the tower that was built. The story uses 20 feet and reports the newspaper plan.

The year 1975 agrees across sources. The Register and Weebly say removed; firelookout.com and SummitPost say destroyed; Willhite says removed or destroyed. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick one.
Construction began in 1914 per a Republic newspaper item and Willhite; the cabin is dated 1915 by the Register and SummitPost. The story gives both.

notes_for_editor: Height corrected: the brief's 4.9 m is 16 feet, which matches the 1930 newspaper plan; the built tower was 20 feet per the Register, firelookout.com and Willhite. Staffing is names and years only; no fire events were found. SummitPost is a climbing site and its account of the summit is secondhand, so the current-condition statements rest on one page. No photo URLs captured because fetch_text returns text only.
